title: War 'n Nature
description: [1.20.1] Adds more diverse, vanilla-like biomes, structures, mods and items stemming from popular mods.
body:
Ancient wars built civilization's remains, you decide to either build it up to what it once was, vanish it or take on a completely different route. Modpack made to amplify exploration, combat resources, sandboxing and keeping the vanilla-style of the game.
# Content Mods:
- Alex's Mobs
- Biomes O' Plenty
- Dungeons and Taverns
- Farmer's Delight
- Spartan Weaponry
- Waystones

All content, libraries and extra mods are made by external users and not myself.
